capabilities: Log trades and track performance on dashboard widgets and a heatmap
Track prop-firm challenges with drawdown, daily loss, profit targets and payout rules
Import trade files from CSV, spreadsheets, HTML and broker statements
Automatically sync trades from supported brokers such as MetaTrader 4 and cTrader
Connect AI apps over MCP to analyse trades and draft reviews
extras: Freemium: a paid Pro subscription is required for Trade Sync, committing Trade Imports, the Economic Calendar and prefilled prop-firm profiles; a Journalit account is needed for authentication-backed features. Proprietary source-available license; PRIVACY.md covers server-side file processing and diagnostic retention.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record trades, compute performance analytics, or bring in broker trade data.

relations.evidence: TradingView: Paper Trading order history and Strategy Tester List of Trades (backtests)
Connect Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Hermes, Grok Bot or another compatible AI app
File-based Trade Import Supported export sources and formats: - IBKR

summary: Trading journal that logs trades in your vault, tracks performance analytics and prop-firm challenges, and imports or syncs trades from brokers.
